entities.summary: "Du hast den schönsten Arsch der Welt" is a German-language song by dance music producer and DJ Alex C.. It was recorded in cooperation with and featuring singer Y-ass. Also in 2007, Basshunter made a remix of the song titled "Du hast den schönsten Arsch der Welt ". The song itself is a cover version of The Soundlovers' 1996 song "Run Away".
